text.36:57: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
text.38:51: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein.
text.43:73: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
text.44:55: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
text.52:22: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
text.55:11: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
text.55:52: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.
text.55:68: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
